name: Unit Economics · CAC Payback
note: Each channel's cumulative contribution starts at minus CAC and climbs as a survival curve of subscribers keeps ordering, so the zero crossing is the payback month; what-if sliders for CAC, order value, margin and churn re-run the model and every curve, KPI delta and table row. Retention cells count their percentages with a registered <integer> custom property fed to a CSS counter, so values tween without JS; set --dex-unit-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Risk Register Heat Map
note: Residual position is inherent minus every completed mitigation, so ticking a mitigation in the detail panel moves that risk across the 5×5 map: each chip is reparented into its new cell and FLIPped there with the Web Animations API, as is every chip when you switch inherent and residual. Cells colour themselves through a two-stage color-mix(in oklch) ramp from per-cell custom properties, the appetite frontier and movement arrows are traced in an SVG overlay from live cell geometry, and the grid is arrow-key navigable; set --dex-risk-h to 100dvh in an app.
